title: PrintScreen Screenshot for RGSS3 not working on Windows 11 machine! Please Help!

posts.author: MoltresRider
posts.body:
Ever since I moved my RPG Maker project to a brand new computer running Windows 11 pro, PrintScreen Screenshot for RGSS3 by Ru/むっくRu (Rutan) | English translation by tale 2017/02/12 no longer works in my game!
No matter how many times I press print screen and no matter what RPG Maker VX Ace game, screenshots are not taken.
I made no changes to the script whatsoever. It just does not take screenshots anymore.
I was previously running RPG Maker VX Ace on an older Windows 7 machine and the script worked fine there.
What could be the problem here?

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body:
Windows 11 takes priority over the keyboard inputs.
I unfortunately don't know of a fix but hopefully somebody with better knowledge of win32_api can find a fix.

posts.author: MoltresRider
posts.body: I disabled "use Print Screen to open screen capture" and it still does not work.

posts.body:

True, I wasn't stating that turning that off would fix it.
You can use Hime Map Screenshot. It still works as it uses buttons that the engine has control over.
i.e. F6 or F8
